mapper.select:
SELECT s.rid, s.battle_type, s.date_add, s.winner_position, s.p1_wizard_id, s.p1_channel_uid, s.p1_name, s.p1_country, s.p1_score, s.p1_rating, s.p1_result, s.p1_first_pick, s.p1_alive_count, s.p1_banned_unit, s.p1_leader_unit, COALESCE(s.p1_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_units, COALESCE(s.p1_unit_images, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_unit_images, COALESCE(s.p1_unit_names, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_unit_names, COALESCE(s.p1_units_str, '') AS p1_units_str, s.p2_wizard_id, s.p2_channel_uid, s.p2_name, s.p2_country, s.p2_score, s.p2_rating, s.p2_result, s.p2_first_pick, s.p2_alive_count, s.p2_banned_unit, s.p2_leader_unit, COALESCE(s.p2_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_units, COALESCE(s.p2_unit_images, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_unit_images, COALESCE(s.p2_unit_names, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_unit_names, COALESCE(s.p2_units_str, '') AS p2_units_str FROM rta_replay_match_snapshot s WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY s.date_add DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.rid, s.battle_type, s.date_add, s.winner_position, s.p1_wizard_id, s.p1_channel_uid, s.p1_name, s.p1_country, s.p1_score, s.p1_rating, s.p1_result, s.p1_first_pick, s.p1_alive_count, s.p1_banned_unit, s.p1_leader_unit, COALESCE(s.p1_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_units, COALESCE(s.p1_unit_images, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_unit_images, COALESCE(s.p1_unit_names, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p1_unit_names, COALESCE(s.p1_units_str, '') AS p1_units_str, s.p2_wizard_id, s.p2_channel_uid, s.p2_name, s.p2_country, s.p2_score, s.p2_rating, s.p2_result, s.p2_first_pick, s.p2_alive_count, s.p2_banned_unit, s.p2_leader_unit, COALESCE(s.p2_units, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_units, COALESCE(s.p2_unit_images, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_unit_images, COALESCE(s.p2_unit_names, ARRAY[]::text[]) AS p2_unit_names, COALESCE(s.p2_units_str, '') AS p2_units_str FROM rta_replay_match_snapshot s WHERE (s.p1_wizard_id = #{wizardId} OR s.p2_wizard_id = #{wizardId})
ORDER BY s.date_add DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM rta_replay_match_snapshot s WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM rta_replay_match_snapshot s WHERE DATE(s.date_add) = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM rta_replay_match_snapshot s WHERE s.date_add >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_matches, COUNT(DISTINCT r.rid) as unique_matches, COUNT(DISTINCT u.wizard_id) as unique_users, COUNT(DISTINCT unit.unit_master_id) as unique_units FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_list r LEFT JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list u ON r.rid = u.rid LEFT JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list unit ON r.rid = unit.rid LIMIT 1

SELECT r.rid, r.battle_type, r.date_add, COUNT(DISTINCT u.wizard_id) as player_count, COUNT(DISTINCT unit.unit_master_id) as unit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.wizard_id) as pick_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_list r LEFT JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list u ON r.rid = u.rid LEFT JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list unit ON r.rid = unit.rid LEFT JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_pick_list p ON r.rid = p.rid GROUP BY r.rid, r.battle_type, r.date_add ORDER BY r.date_add DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT 'user_list' as table_name, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list WHERE rid = #{rid} UNION ALL SELECT 'unit_list' as table_name, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list WHERE rid = #{rid} UNION ALL SELECT 'pick_list' as table_name, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_pick_list WHERE rid = #{rid}

WITH , match_count AS ( SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS total_matches FROM replay_list_dedup ), pick_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name as monster_name, COALESCE(m.image_url, '/images/' || m.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png') as monster_image, COUNT(*) as pick_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN u.pick_slot_id = 1 THEN 1 END) as first_pick_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON u.rid = r.rid LEFT JOIN monster m ON u.unit_master_id = m.monster_id WHERE m.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name, m.un_name, m.image_url ), ban_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) as ban_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_pick_list p JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u ON p.rid = u.rid AND p.wizard_id = u.wizard_id AND p.banned_slot_id = u.pick_slot_id INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON p.rid = r.rid WHERE p.banned_slot_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.unit_master_id ), win_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) as win_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list ul ON u.rid = ul.rid AND u.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON u.rid = r.rid WHERE r.wizard_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM ul.wizard_id::text) = TRIM(BOTH FROM r.wizard_id::text) GROUP BY u.unit_master_id ) SELECT ps.unit_master_id as monster_id, ps.monster_elemental, ps.monster_name, ps.monster_image, ps.pick_count, ROUND((ps.pick_count::numeric / mc.total_matches * 100)::numeric, 2) as pick_rate, CASE WHEN ps.pick_count > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(ws.win_count, 0)::numeric / ps.pick_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, CASE WHEN ps.pick_count > 0 THEN ROUND((ps.first_pick_count::numeric / ps.pick_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as first_pick_rate, ROUND((COALESCE(bs.ban_count, 0)::numeric / mc.total_matches * 100)::numeric, 2) as ban_rate FROM pick_stats ps CROSS JOIN match_count mc LEFT JOIN ban_stats bs ON ps.unit_master_id = bs.unit_master_id LEFT JOIN win_stats ws ON ps.unit_master_id = ws.unit_master_id WHERE ps.pick_count > 0 ORDER BY ps.pick_count DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

WITH , field_units AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u.rid, u.wizard_id, TRIM(BOTH FROM u.unit_master_id::text) AS unit_master_id FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u INNER JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_pick_list p ON u.rid = p.rid AND u.wizard_id = p.wizard_id WHERE TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(u.unit_master_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND ( p.banned_slot_id IS NULL OR u.pick_slot_id <> p.banned_slot_id ) ), duo AS ( SELECT u1.unit_master_id AS id1, u2.unit_master_id AS id2, COUNT(*) AS match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.wizard_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM ul.wizard_id::text) = TRIM(BOTH FROM r.wizard_id::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count FROM field_units u1 INNER JOIN field_units u2 ON u1.rid = u2.rid AND u1.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id AND u1.unit_master_id::bigint < u2.unit_master_id::bigint INNER JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list ul ON u1.rid = ul.rid AND u1.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON u1.rid = r.rid GROUP BY u1.unit_master_id, u2.unit_master_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) SELECT d.id1::text AS monster_id_1, d.id2::text AS monster_id_2, m1.kr_name AS monster_name_1, m2.kr_name AS monster_name_2, COALESCE(m1.image_url, '/images/' || m1.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m1.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m1.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png') AS monster_image_1, COALESCE(m2.image_url, '/images/' || m2.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m2.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m2.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png') AS monster_image_2, m1.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_1, m2.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_2, d.match_count, ROUND((d.win_count::numeric / NULLIF(d.match_count, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS win_rate FROM duo d LEFT JOIN monster m1 ON d.id1 = m1.monster_id LEFT JOIN monster m2 ON d.id2 = m2.monster_id WHERE m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (d.win_count::numeric / NULLIF(d.match_count, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST, d.match_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH , field_units AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u.rid, u.wizard_id, TRIM(BOTH FROM u.unit_master_id::text) AS unit_master_id FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r0 ON u.rid = r0.rid INNER JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_pick_list p ON u.rid = p.rid AND u.wizard_id = p.wizard_id WHERE TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(u.unit_master_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND ( p.banned_slot_id IS NULL OR u.pick_slot_id <> p.banned_slot_id ) ), trio AS ( SELECT u1.unit_master_id AS id1, u2.unit_master_id AS id2, u3.unit_master_id AS id3, COUNT(*) AS match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.wizard_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM ul.wizard_id::text) = TRIM(BOTH FROM r.wizard_id::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count FROM field_units u1 INNER JOIN field_units u2 ON u1.rid = u2.rid AND u1.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id AND u1.unit_master_id::bigint < u2.unit_master_id::bigint INNER JOIN field_units u3 ON u2.rid = u3.rid AND u2.wizard_id = u3.wizard_id AND u2.unit_master_id::bigint < u3.unit_master_id::bigint INNER JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list ul ON u1.rid = ul.rid AND u1.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON u1.rid = r.rid GROUP BY u1.unit_master_id, u2.unit_master_id, u3.unit_master_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) SELECT t.id1::text AS monster_id_1, t.id2::text AS monster_id_2, t.id3::text AS monster_id_3, m1.kr_name AS monster_name_1, m2.kr_name AS monster_name_2, m3.kr_name AS monster_name_3, COALESCE(m1.image_url, '/images/' || m1.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m1.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m1.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png') AS monster_image_1, COALESCE(m2.image_url, '/images/' || m2.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m2.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m2.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png') AS monster_image_2, COALESCE(m3.image_url, '/images/' || m3.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m3.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m3.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png') AS monster_image_3, m1.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_1, m2.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_2, m3.monster_elemental AS monster_elemental_3, t.match_count, ROUND((t.win_count::numeric / NULLIF(t.match_count, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS win_rate FROM trio t LEFT JOIN monster m1 ON t.id1 = m1.monster_id LEFT JOIN monster m2 ON t.id2 = m2.monster_id LEFT JOIN monster m3 ON t.id3 = m3.monster_id WHERE m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m3.kr_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (t.win_count::numeric / NULLIF(t.match_count, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST, t.match_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH , match_count AS ( SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint as total_matches FROM replay_list_dedup r ), pick_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name as monster_name, COALESCE(m.image_url, '/images/' || m.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png') as monster_image, COUNT(*) as pick_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN u.pick_slot_id = 1 THEN 1 END) as first_pick_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON u.rid = r.rid LEFT JOIN monster m ON u.unit_master_id = m.monster_id WHERE m.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name, m.un_name, m.image_url ), ban_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) as ban_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_pick_list p JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u ON p.rid = u.rid AND p.wizard_id = u.wizard_id AND p.banned_slot_id = u.pick_slot_id INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON p.rid = r.rid WHERE p.banned_slot_id IS NOT NULL AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id ), win_stats AS ( SELECT u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) as win_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list ul ON u.rid = ul.rid AND u.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON u.rid = r.rid WHERE r.wizard_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM ul.wizard_id::text) = TRIM(BOTH FROM r.wizard_id::text) AND u.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} GROUP BY u.unit_master_id ) SELECT ps.unit_master_id as monster_id, ps.monster_elemental, ps.monster_name, ps.monster_image, ps.pick_count, ROUND((ps.pick_count::numeric / mc.total_matches * 100)::numeric, 2) as pick_rate, CASE WHEN ps.pick_count > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(ws.win_count, 0)::numeric / ps.pick_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, CASE WHEN ps.pick_count > 0 THEN ROUND((ps.first_pick_count::numeric / ps.pick_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as first_pick_rate, ROUND((COALESCE(bs.ban_count, 0)::numeric / mc.total_matches * 100)::numeric, 2) as ban_rate FROM pick_stats ps CROSS JOIN match_count mc LEFT JOIN ban_stats bs ON ps.unit_master_id = bs.unit_master_id LEFT JOIN win_stats ws ON ps.unit_master_id = ws.unit_master_id LIMIT 1

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.rid, u1.wizard_id FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u1 INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r0 ON u1.rid = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), opponent_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as opponent_monster_id, m.monster_elemental as opponent_monster_elemental, m.kr_name as opponent_monster_name, COALESCE(m.image_url, '/images/' || m.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png') as opponent_monster_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.wizard_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM ul1.wizard_id::text) = TRIM(BOTH FROM r.wizard_id::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u2 ON mm.rid = u2.rid JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list ul1 ON mm.rid = ul1.rid AND mm.wizard_id = ul1.wizard_id JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list ul2 ON mm.rid = ul2.rid AND u2.wizard_id = ul2.wizard_id AND ul1.wizard_id != ul2.wizard_id JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON mm.rid = r.rid LEFT JOIN monster m ON u2.unit_master_id = m.monster_id WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name, m.un_name, m.image_url HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) SELECT opponent_monster_id as monster_id, opponent_monster_elemental as monster_elemental, opponent_monster_name as monster_name, opponent_monster_image as monster_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM opponent_stats ORDER BY win_rate DESC, match_count DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.rid, u1.wizard_id FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u1 INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r0 ON u1.rid = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), combo_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as combo_monster_id, m.monster_elemental as combo_monster_elemental, m.kr_name as combo_monster_name, COALESCE(m.image_url, '/images/' || m.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png') as combo_monster_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.wizard_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM ul.wizard_id::text) = TRIM(BOTH FROM r.wizard_id::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u2 ON mm.rid = u2.rid AND mm.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list ul ON mm.rid = ul.rid AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON mm.rid = r.rid LEFT JOIN monster m ON u2.unit_master_id = m.monster_id WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m.monster_elemental, m.kr_name, m.un_name, m.image_url HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ) SELECT combo_monster_id as monster_id, combo_monster_elemental as monster_elemental, combo_monster_name as monster_name, combo_monster_image as monster_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM combo_stats ORDER BY win_rate DESC, match_count DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( -- 내가 사용한 매치들 SELECT DISTINCT u1.rid, u1.wizard_id FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u1 INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r0 ON u1.rid = r0.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ), triple_combo_stats AS ( SELECT u2.unit_master_id as monster1_id, m1.monster_elemental as monster1_elemental, m1.kr_name as monster1_name, '/images/' || m1.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m1.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m1.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png' as monster1_image, u3.unit_master_id as monster2_id, m2.monster_elemental as monster2_elemental, m2.kr_name as monster2_name, '/images/' || m2.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m2.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m2.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png' as monster2_image, COUNT(*) as match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.wizard_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM ul.wizard_id::text) = TRIM(BOTH FROM r.wizard_id::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as win_count FROM my_matches mm JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u2 ON mm.rid = u2.rid AND mm.wizard_id = u2.wizard_id JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u3 ON mm.rid = u3.rid AND mm.wizard_id = u3.wizard_id JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list ul ON mm.rid = ul.rid AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON mm.rid = r.rid LEFT JOIN monster m1 ON u2.unit_master_id = m1.monster_id LEFT JOIN monster m2 ON u3.unit_master_id = m2.monster_id WHERE u2.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND u3.unit_master_id != #{monsterId} AND u2.unit_master_id < u3.unit_master_id AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u2.unit_master_id, m1.monster_elemental, m1.kr_name, m1.un_name, u3.unit_master_id, m2.monster_elemental, m2.kr_name, m2.un_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) SELECT monster1_id, monster1_elemental, monster1_name, monster1_image, monster2_id, monster2_elemental, monster2_name, monster2_image, CASE WHEN match_count > 0 THEN ROUND((win_count::numeric / match_count * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END as win_rate, match_count FROM triple_combo_stats ORDER BY win_rate DESC, match_count DESC LIMIT 20

WITH , my_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u1.rid, u1.wizard_id, r.date_add FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u1 INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON u1.rid = r.rid WHERE u1.unit_master_id = #{monsterId} ORDER BY r.date_add DESC LIMIT 20 ), my_team_json AS ( SELECT mm.rid, mm.wizard_id, json_agg( json_build_object( 'monster_id', u1.unit_master_id, 'monster_name', COALESCE(m1.kr_name, ''), 'monster_image', CASE WHEN m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL THEN '/images/' || m1.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m1.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m1.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png' ELSE '' END ) ORDER BY u1.pick_slot_id ) as my_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u1 ON mm.rid = u1.rid AND mm.wizard_id = u1.wizard_id LEFT JOIN monster m1 ON u1.unit_master_id = m1.monster_id GROUP BY mm.rid, mm.wizard_id ), opponent_team_json AS ( SELECT mm.rid, json_agg( json_build_object( 'monster_id', u2.unit_master_id, 'monster_name', COALESCE(m2.kr_name, ''), 'monster_image', CASE WHEN m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL THEN '/images/' || m2.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(m2.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || m2.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png' ELSE '' END ) ORDER BY u2.pick_slot_id ) as opponent_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u2 ON mm.rid = u2.rid AND mm.wizard_id != u2.wizard_id LEFT JOIN monster m2 ON u2.unit_master_id = m2.monster_id GROUP BY mm.rid ) SELECT mm.rid as match_id, mm.date_add as match_date, CASE WHEN r.wizard_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(BOTH FROM ul.wizard_id::text) = TRIM(BOTH FROM r.wizard_id::text) THEN 'WIN' ELSE 'LOSE' END as win_lose, COALESCE(mt.my_team::text, '[]') as my_team, COALESCE(ot.opponent_team::text, '[]') as opponent_team FROM my_matches mm JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list ul ON mm.rid = ul.rid AND mm.wizard_id = ul.wizard_id JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON mm.rid = r.rid LEFT JOIN my_team_json mt ON mm.rid = mt.rid AND mm.wizard_id = mt.wizard_id LEFT JOIN opponent_team_json ot ON mm.rid = ot.rid ORDER BY mm.date_add DESC

SELECT bucket_date, tier_key, player_count, sort_order FROM rta_tier_distribution_daily_agg WHERE 1 = 1
AND bucket_date >= (#{seasonStart})::date AND bucket_date < (#{seasonEnd})::date
ORDER BY bucket_date, sort_order

WITH SELECT bucket_date, tier_key, COUNT(*)::bigint AS player_count, MIN(sort_order)::int AS sort_order FROM ( SELECT t.bucket_date, ( CASE WHEN t.rating_val >= 5000 THEN 'L' WHEN t.rating_val >= 4000 THEN 'G' WHEN t.rating_val >= 3500 THEN 'P' WHEN t.rating_val >= 3000 THEN 'C' WHEN t.rating_val >= 2000 THEN 'F' ELSE 'Ch' END ) || CASE WHEN (t.rating_val % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (t.rating_val % 10)::text ELSE '2' END AS tier_key, ( CASE WHEN t.rating_val >= 5000 THEN 60 WHEN t.rating_val >= 4000 THEN 50 WHEN t.rating_val >= 3500 THEN 40 WHEN t.rating_val >= 3000 THEN 30 WHEN t.rating_val >= 2000 THEN 20 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN (t.rating_val % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (t.rating_val % 10) ELSE 2 END ) AS sort_order FROM ( SELECT r.date_add::date AS bucket_date, MAX(CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT)) AS rating_val FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list u INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON u.rid = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.rating_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 1000 GROUP BY r.date_add::date, u.wizard_id ) t ) x GROUP BY bucket_date, tier_key ORDER BY bucket_date, MIN(sort_order)

WITH , anchors AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, '3h', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '3 hours'), (2, '6h', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '6 hours'), (3, '12h', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '12 hours'), (4, '3d', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '3 days'), (5, '7d', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days') ) AS v(sort_order, anchor_key, ts) ), base AS ( SELECT r.date_add, CAST(TRIM(u.score::text) AS INT) AS score_val, ( CASE WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 5000 THEN 'L' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 4000 THEN 'G' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 3500 THEN 'P' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 3000 THEN 'C' WHEN CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 2000 THEN 'F' ELSE 'Ch' END ) || CASE WHEN (CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) % 10)::text ELSE '2' END AS tier_key FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list u INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON u.rid = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.rating_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.rating_id::text) AS INT) >= 1000 AND TRIM(COALESCE(u.score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.score::text) AS INT) > 0 AND r.date_add::date >= ( SELECT (MAX(r2.date_add::date) - INTERVAL '120 days')::date FROM replay_list_dedup r2 ) ), tiers AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('G3'), ('G2'), ('G1'), ('P3'), ('P2'), ('P1') ) AS tv(tier_key) ) SELECT sub.sort_order, sub.anchor_key, sub.tier_key, sub.cutoff_score FROM ( SELECT a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, t.tier_key, COALESCE( (SELECT MIN(b.score_val) FROM base b WHERE b.tier_key = t.tier_key AND b.date_add::date = (a.ts)::date AND b.date_add <= a.ts), (SELECT MIN(b.score_val) FROM base b WHERE b.tier_key = t.tier_key AND b.date_add <= a.ts AND b.date_add >= (a.ts - INTERVAL '7 days')), (SELECT MIN(b.score_val) FROM base b WHERE b.tier_key = t.tier_key AND b.date_add <= a.ts), (SELECT MIN(b.score_val) FROM base b WHERE b.date_add <= a.ts AND SUBSTRING(b.tier_key, 1, 1) = SUBSTRING(t.tier_key, 1, 1)), 1000 )::bigint AS cutoff_score FROM anchors a CROSS JOIN tiers t ) sub ORDER BY sub.sort_order, sub.tier_key

WITH SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.wizard_id) u.wizard_id FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list u INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON u.rid = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.score::text) AS INT) > 0 ORDER BY u.wizard_id, r.date_add DESC ) t

TRIM(COALESCE(u.score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.score::text) AS INT) > 0 ORDER BY u.wizard_id, r.date_add DESC ), win_agg AS ( SELECT u.wizard_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS match_count, latest ), page_ranked AS ( SELECT * FROM ranked ORDER BY rank_position LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ), field_pick_counts AS ( SELECT u.wizard_id, TRIM(BOTH FROM u.unit_master_id::text) AS COALESCE(u.unit_master_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND ( p.banned_slot_id IS NULL OR u.pick_slot_id <> p.banned_slot_id ) AND u.wizard_id IN (SELECT wizard_id FROM page_ranked) GROUP BY u.wizard_id, BIGINT) ASC ) AS rn FROM field_pick_counts ), most1 AS ( SELECT wizard_id, unit_master_id AS m1_id, pick_count AS m1_pick FROM ranked_monsters WHERE rn = 1 ), most2 AS ( SELECT wizard_id, unit_master_id AS m2_id, pick_count AS m2_pick FROM ranked_monsters WHERE rn = 2 ), most3 AS ( SELECT wizard_id, unit_master_id AS m3_id, pick_count AS m3_pick FROM ranked_monsters WHERE rn = 3 ) most_monster_2_id, m2.m2_pick AS most_monster_2_pick_count, COALESCE(mm2.kr_name, '') AS most_monster_2_name, COALESCE( mm2.image_url, CASE WHEN mm2.kr_name IS NOT NULL THEN '/images/' || mm2.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(mm2.un_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || mm2.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png' ELSE '' END ) AS most_monster_2_image, m3.m3_id::text AS most_monster_3_id, m3.m3_pick AS most1 m1 ON pr.wizard_id = m1.wizard_id LEFT JOIN monster mm1 ON m1.m1_id IS NOT NULL AND mm1.monster_id = m1.m1_id LEFT JOIN most2 m2 ON pr.wizard_id = m2.wizard_id LEFT JOIN monster mm2 ON m2.m2_id IS NOT NULL AND mm2.monster_id = m2.m2_id LEFT JOIN most3 m3 ON pr.wizard_id = m3.wizard_id LEFT JOIN monster mm3 ON m3.m3_id IS NOT NULL AND mm3.monster_id = m3.m3_id ORDER BY pr.rank_position

r.wizard_id::text) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS win_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_user_list u INNER JOIN replay_list_dedup r ON u.rid = r.rid WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(u.score::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(TRIM(u.score::text) AS INT) > 0 GROUP BY u.wizard_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT latest.wizard_id, latest.wizard_name, latest.country, latest.channel_uid, latest.score, latest.rating_id, u.wizard_id, TRIM(BOTH FROM u.unit_master_id::text) AS unit_master_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS pick_count FROM ranker_rtpvp_replay_unit_list u INNER JOIN ranker_rtpvp_replay_pick_list p ON u.rid = p.rid AND u.wizard_id = p.wizard_id WHERE TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(u.unit_master_id::text, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND ( p.banned_slot_id IS NULL OR u.pick_slot_id <> p.banned_slot_id ) AND u.wizard_id IN (SELECT wizard_id FROM full_ranked) GROUP BY u.wizard_id, TRIM(BOTH FROM u.unit_master_id::text) ), ranked_monsters AS ( SELECT wizard_id, unit_master_id, pick_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY wizard_id ORDER BY pick_count DESC, CAST(unit_master_id AS BIGINT) ASC ) AS rn FROM field_pick_counts ), most1 AS ( SELECT wizard_id, unit_master_id AS m1_id, pick_count AS m1_pick FROM ranked_monsters WHERE rn = 1 ), most2 AS ( SELECT wizard_id, unit_master_id AS m2_id, pick_count AS m2_pick FROM ranked_monsters WHERE rn = 2 ), most3 AS ( SELECT wizard_id, unit_master_id AS m3_id, '_Icon.png' ELSE '' END ) AS most_monster_3_image FROM full_ranked pr LEFT JOIN win_agg wa ON pr.wizard_id = wa.wizard_id LEFT JOIN most1 m1 ON pr.wizard_id = m1.wizard_id LEFT JOIN monster mm1 ON m1.m1_id IS NOT NULL AND mm1.monster_id = m1.m1_id LEFT JOIN most2 m2 ON pr.wizard_id = m2.wizard_id LEFT JOIN monster mm2 ON m2.m2_id IS NOT NULL AND mm2.monster_id = m2.m2_id LEFT JOIN most3 m3 ON
